thread:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> runtime-queueing-high-latency triggered. Notifying #eng-oncall.

maria: Paging oncall — seeing queue depth spike across runtime pool, tail token latency spikes, some 5xx and 429s. Happening since ~11:07.

josh: Oncall here. Confirmed from Grafana: per-worker max_in_flight=48, global queued ~12k, 95th token latency >3s. Customer-facing failures ~3.9% (mostly chat/generate).

maria: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) reduce max_in_flight on standard pool to 20 (canary first), 2) enable request shedding for requests >5s, 3) soft rate-limit non-enterprise traffic to protect SLOs.

josh: Acknowledged. Running canary change now.

maria: Command I'm running: `./infra/scripts/runtime-config set --pool standard-us-west --max_in_flight 20 --canary=true`

infra-bot: Config apply started -> nodes targeted: 6, canary size: 2. Updates applied to node-3 and node-4.

infra-bot: Node node-3: max_in_flight set to 20. Node node-4: max_in_flight set to 20. Queue depth on those nodes down ~60% in 90s.

sachin: We should avoid breaking big customers — suggest temporary quota bump for project `acme-prod` (+2x for 30m) while we stabilize the pool. Otherwise they see 429s.

josh: Bumped acme-prod quota: `admin-console project update --id acme-prod --burst-multiplier 2 --ttl 30m` — confirmed.

carol: Also toggled feature flag to reduce long-lived connections: `feature-flags set embeddings-stream false` (this reduces streaming/long contexts load).

erica: Customer impact summary: primary hit on long-context interactive chats (>4k tokens) and streaming embeddings. A few Enterprise customers reported intermittent UI errors; most traffic degraded gracefully.

maria: Metrics look better on canary nodes. Plan: roll to remaining nodes in waves of 2 nodes every 2m if error rate stays <1% and queue drops.

sachin: If we see a rollback, threshold to trigger aggressive shedding: queued >5000 or p95 latency >5s — then flip shedding to 'aggressive' and route heavy requests to model-lite variants.

josh: Rolling change now: applying to node-1 and node-2.

infra-bot: node-1/2 updated. Global queue across pool dropping. Error rate down to 1.1%.

maria: Leaving a short runbook note for handoff: what we changed, commands used, and fallback thresholds (queue>5k, p95>5s, re-enable embeddings-stream).

josh: Handoff to night oncall @tara — sitrep pinned, acme-prod on temporary quota, canary successful, rolling to remaining nodes. If queue resurges, please escalate and enable aggressive shedding + model-lite fallback.

tara: Taking it. Thanks — I'll watch the dashboard and keep acme contact in the loop.

incidents-bot: Incident state updated -> mitigations_applied. Update: please file postmortem if we keep quotas or flags beyond 1 hour.

maria: Filing a short incident note and capture timeline. We'll reopen if new alerts fire. :lock:
